[&larr; Back to Datasets](../index.qmd)

The "final form" of this dataset evolved over a few stages:

* First, Jeff announced in class that the dataset would comprise [UN Comtrade](https://comtradeplus.un.org/) data merged with vessel arrival and departure data from [IMF PortWatch](https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/data-and-methodology). Unfortunately, Georgetown does not subscribe to Comtrade, so I'm unable to bulk-export that data
* Next, we tried the UN Food and Agriculture Organization's FAOSTAT ["Detailed Trade Matrix"](https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/TM): this dataset *is* available in full, but is **aggregated** to the (sender, receiver, product, year) level
* For the **microdata** we really want – so that we can simulate the kind of **individual financial transaction data** that you might encounter as a data scientist in **Retail Sales**, it turns out that Colombia's *Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE)* provides individual-transaction level data!

With that note on the trajectory of this dataset out of the way, here is your vignette and accompanying sample midterm questions:
